newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen weak ahead of 1997/98 budget.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen weak ahead of 1997/98 budget.

text.p: Pakistan stocks are likely to remain weak on Monday on lack of investor interest before the 1997/98 (July-June) budget on June 14, dealers said.

"There is little interest from investors ahead of the budget," dealer Rony Byramjee said. "There are fears of another devaluation of the rupee and investors are in no mood to enter the market at present."
On Friday, the index fell 0.02 points, to end at 1,507.96. Losers led gainers by 156 to 75. Turnover rose to 18.18 million shares from 16.96 million in the previous session.
